about: Recorded from src/services/graph/nodes.py::_advisory_text. tests/unit/test_finding_conformance.py::TestDeckAdvisoryGolden rebuilds each case's findings (slide_index -1 for a deck-level criterion, 0 otherwise) and requires the writer to return `advisory` exactly, and `split` to be `advisory` partitioned at the first REVIEWER_DETAILS_SEPARATOR (null when it has none). frontend/src/utils/findingText.test.ts requires splitDeckAdvisory(advisory) to equal `split`. When the writer's format changes, replace `advisory` and `split` with the values that Python test prints, never with hand-written ones.
